property_summary: For any caller, a setL1BlockValues call should revert unless the caller is the current depositorAccount; the reference reverts for any caller that is not the current depositorAccount, while the buggy version allows the constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT to always succeed regardless of the depositorAccount state.
change_summary: Change depositorAccount to DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT in the require statement, making the check pass for the constant address instead of the writable storage variable.
